claims.claim: no fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: No new photos; fungus/scratches can be hidden and require rear-element and edge close-ups with raking light.

claims.evidence: Seller text without supporting video/photo proof (AF test, sharpness, mount seating, included accessories).

risks.risk: Hidden fungus/haze/scratches on rear element or lens edges not visible in current photos
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of BOTH front and rear elements with raking light (flash at an angle) and photos of lens edges.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with unknown glass condition (worst case: possible minor defects).

risks.risk: AF performance may be weak or inconsistent even if it “works” briefly
risks.proof: Request a short video of autofocus acquiring focus on a camera body (near + far), plus a still showing sharpness at both distances.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed to autofocus perfectly (worst case: AF may be weak).

risks.risk: Mount/contacts damage or slight play causing mounting issues
risks.proof: Request a clear photo of the mount/bayonet and contacts, and a video showing the lens seated firmly on a camera.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mount condition unknown (worst case: possible minor play).

risks.risk: Accessories mismatch (battery/charger claim) and missing caps/hood not shown
risks.proof: Request a photo of everything included laid out (front cap, rear cap, hood, any box/pouch).
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens only (worst case: missing accessories).

proof_requests: Send new photos: rear element close-up + both glass surfaces with raking light (flash at an angle).
Send a video: mount on a camera and show autofocus acquiring focus (near and far).

response.reason: The seller’s reply is not supported by new visual evidence. Key pricing drivers (rear glass condition, AF performance, mount condition, and included accessories) remain unprovable from the current photos, and the shutter-count/battery/charger claims don’t align with lens-only imagery.
